review: Internal AI-assisted complete-page visual review; not independent peer review
method: All page contact sheets inspected; dense new tables, new figures, equations and changed pages additionally inspected at page resolution. Final bibliography and graphic-led section breaks corrected and rechecked.
automatic_checks: No off-page text, body/footer collisions or replacement characters; figure assets, caption uniqueness, bibliography entries and include expansion pass.
author_placeholders: Intentional and retained for true author information; no final author approval asserted.
